user.title: Connect ZSpace NAS

data_description.host: Leave empty to use the oauth.zconnect.cn relay; use https://IP:5055 for direct LAN access.
data_description.allow_insecure_http: Only when the device has no trusted certificate; tokens will travel in clear text.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthorize ZSpace
reauth_confirm.description: The session expired. Authorize again on your computer, replace `{profile_dir}`, then submit.

error.auth: Session invalid or expired, please reauthorize
error.binary_missing: zspace-cli not found or not executable
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the NAS, check address and network

abort.already_configured: This ZSpace device is already configured

data.dry_run: Dry run (log only, do not execute)

data_description.allow_control: Creates container switches and restart buttons. Delete, force-stop and engine power are never exposed.
data_description.allowed_containers: Comma separated name fragments; use * to allow all (protected system containers still denied). Empty = monitoring only.
data_description.dry_run: Switch presses are only logged, no command is sent. Useful to observe behaviour first.
data_description.protected_containers: Comma separated, matches name fragments. Names containing zspace/znas/zido/zvm are protected by default.
data_description.action_cooldown: Prevents scripts or double taps from hammering the same container.
data_description.download_interval: Download tasks change slowly, 5 minutes by default.
data_description.disk_interval: SMART is queried per disk (~0.4s each), 1 hour by default.

container_action.name: Container action
container_action.description: Start, stop or restart a ZSpace Docker container.

dump_raw.name: Dump raw data
dump_raw.description: Call one read-only capability and write the raw JSON to /config/zspace_nas/.
